subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this issue remain a separate WhatsApp 515 finalization tracker, or should the active phone-code login PR be required to prove and fix restart-free recovery before this issue can close?
rationale: Current main cannot exercise the reported phone-code path, and the open PRs solve the login entrypoint and partial credentials but do not yet prove the broader manual gateway-restart recovery gap is eliminated.

options.title: Require Proof In Phone-Code Lane
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the active phone-code branch to either prove restart-free 515 finalization or explicitly leave a separate recovery follow-up before closing it.

options.title: Split A Recovery Issue
options.body: Treat phone-code login as separate from 515 finalization and create or designate a narrower WhatsApp auth/session recovery tracker after the login PR direction is settled.

options.title: Accept Manual Restart As Documented
options.body: If maintainers consider gateway restart an acceptable recovery step, close this only after documenting that operational behavior and linking the accepted phone-code path.

recommendation.title: Require Proof In Phone-Code Lane
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the active phone-code branch to either prove restart-free 515 finalization or explicitly leave a separate recovery follow-up before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses public CLI behavior, plugin auth contract shape, and WhatsApp recovery policy, where recent history makes steipete the clearest routing owner.
